question: Which articles of the Indian Constitution contain provisions regarding Fundamental Rights?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Articles 12 to 35**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Articles 12 to 35** of the Indian Constitution deal with **Fundamental Rights**.
 
• **Article 12**:
 
 
• Defines the term "State" in relation to Fundamental Rights, which helps in determining the scope of rights that are protected.
 
 
 
• **Articles 13 to 35**:
 
 
• These articles outline specific **Fundamental Rights** including rights to equality, freedom of speech, protection against discrimination, etc., and the mechanisms for their enforcement.
